issue_context.title: Svelte 5: in an `#each` block, setting a deeply nested value misses intermediate props
comments:
I tried to split the binding into one-way data passing + event, and it is _still_ wrong:
```svelte
<input
  value={person.name.first}
  oninput={e => person.name.first = e.targe.value} />
```
Output for event:
```js
$.event("input", input_1, e => $.unwrap(person).first = e.targe.value, false);
```

review_comments: I honestly can't remember anymore why I originally did it like this, but if the tests pass I guess all is good 😄
